title: SYNTHETIC PROBE: Exercise training and quality of life in heart failure: a randomised trial
abstractText: Background Exercise may help patients. Methods We randomly assigned 200 patients to supervised exercise or usual care. Quality of life was measured with the KCCQ questionnaire at 12 weeks. Results Mean KCCQ score improved by 5 points with exercise. Conclusions Exercise improved quality of life.
